skill.name: pricewin-booking-assistant
skill.description: Recommends hotel rooms, creates confirmed OpenTravel bookings and payment links, checks status, renews links, and handles token-protected cancellations.
skill.summary: Manage hotel discovery, recommendation, booking, payment links, status checks, and cancellations through the PriceWin MCP server.
skill.author: PriceWin

security_audit.summary: The apparent shell execution and path traversal findings are Markdown formatting and relative documentation links, not executable behavior. The material risks are real booking authority and transmission of guest PII and verbatim requests to PriceWin's closed-source hosted service.

remediation.issue: The skill can create real reservations and payment links with financial consequences.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce confirmation and idempotency on the backend, and reject duplicate booking requests for the same confirmed itinerary.

remediation.issue: Guest PII and the user's verbatim request are sent to a closed-source hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Remove queryText unless essential, redact unrelated sensitive text, obtain explicit consent, and publish retention and deletion controls.

remediation.issue: Users must trust booking and payment URLs returned by the hosted backend.
remediation.suggestion: Validate destination domains against a documented allowlist and preserve clear disclosure before users open payment links.

content.value_statement: Comparing rooms and completing a booking across providers requires several careful steps. This skill guides discovery, confirmation, payment links, status checks, and cancellation.
actual_capabilities: Searches live hotel inventory and polls until results are ready.
Ranks hotels using ratings and review counts, then recommends suitable rooms.
Retrieves current room details, total price, currency, and cancellation terms.
Creates confirmed OpenTravel reservations and returns hosted payment links.
Checks booking status, renews expired payment links, and performs token-protected cancellations.
Provides direct provider links for Booking.com, Agoda, and Traveloka inventory.
limitations: Requires an approved PriceWin MCP server, whose hosted backend is closed-source.
Only OpenTravel direct properties can be booked within the skill.
The booking flow sends guest PII and the original request to PriceWin.
Prices and availability can change, and the skill does not convert currencies.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Business Travel

use_cases.title: Manage an Existing Reservation

prompt_templates.title: Find a Hotel
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotels in [city] from [check-in] to [check-out] for [guest count]. Show three strong options within [budget].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with dates, location, guests, and budget

prompt_templates.title: Compare Rooms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available rooms at [hotel] for my dates. Include total price, capacity, rating, review count, and cancellation terms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed room comparison before selecting an option

prompt_templates.title: Create a Booking
prompt_templates.prompt: Book the selected OpenTravel room. Ask for all required guest details, show the complete summary, and wait for my explicit confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Confirmed reservation with personal data and payment method

prompt_templates.title: Recover or Cancel a Booking
prompt_templates.prompt: For confirmation code [code], check status first. Renew the payment link if expired, or begin token-protected cancellation when requested.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced management of an existing reservation

output_examples.output: Seaside Central Hotel, rated 8.7 from 1,240 reviews. Deluxe Double costs 108 USD nightly. Free cancellation applies until the displayed deadline.

output_examples.input: Book the selected room using PayPal.
output_examples.output: Please confirm the hotel, room, dates, two guests, full total, guest name, email, phone number, and PayPal before I create the reservation.

output_examples.input: My payment link expired for confirmation code K7X9M2P4.
output_examples.output: I will renew the payment link for the existing reservation. The confirmation code remains K7X9M2P4, so no duplicate booking is created.

best_practices: Verify current room details and total price immediately before requesting confirmation.
Collect only required guest data and ensure the guest types the email address.
Keep the confirmation code and renew expired links instead of creating another booking.
anti_patterns: Do not create a booking before the user confirms every detail and the full total.
Do not ask for card numbers, CVV values, bank credentials, or PayPal passwords.
Do not present OTA inventory as booked or construct provider URLs manually.

faq.question: Which hotels can this skill book directly?
faq.answer: Only OpenTravel direct properties with a property ID and room type ID can be booked through this skill.

faq.question: Can it book Booking.com, Agoda, or Traveloka rooms?
faq.answer: No. It can show returned provider links, but the user completes those reservations on the provider site.

faq.question: Does the skill handle card or bank credentials?
faq.answer: No. It returns a hosted payment link, and the user enters payment credentials on the provider page.

faq.question: What personal data is transmitted?
faq.answer: PriceWin receives the guest name, phone, email, booking details, payment-method choice, and original request text.

faq.question: What happens when a payment link expires?
faq.answer: The skill renews the link for the existing confirmation code. It must not create a second reservation.

faq.question: How does cancellation work?
faq.answer: The guest receives a single-use cancellation token by email and must provide it before cancellation can complete.
